results.title: Extraordinary Aliens
results.overview: This feature-length documentary film, Extraordinary Aliens, started from a personal attempt to document a specific context—people who have migrated from China to the U.S. for higher education in arts and lingered in NYC as art makers and workers. It followed the lives of four artist friends: Lu Zhang, Xingze Li, Yulin Gu, Yushu Wang—how they make work, how they make money, what they eat, where they find home.  And then it grew into broader stories about why and how we stay, or not stay; why and how we make art, or are not able to; about transformation from privileged students to constrained laborers; about being queer, about what kinship means to us when being away from home and the way money and care weaves through; about memory and emotions, vulnerability and interdependence; and last but not least, about making home meals together and sharing recipes.

results.title: The Bell-Eyed Goat
results.overview: A shepherd sets out in search of his lost goat, only to find himself lost in time. A Free adaption of the story of the Little Bell-Hoofed Goat.

results.title: The Country Gentlewoman
results.overview: A Georgian era inspired short film that brings you the best of festive entertaining. Join Arabella and Margaret as they navigate the complexities of tricky ex-partners, the art of hosting, and perfect wine pairings.

results.title: Tom's Dress
results.overview: The short film is called ‘Toms Dress’ its a Social realist, Coming of Age Drama it revolves around this boy wants to pursue being a designer in commemoration of he’s passed away mother, however he feels he need to repress his identity from his abusive father.Through out the film he secretly designs a dress for his mother , the film tackles with some pretty heavy topics like dysfunctional family dynamics, abuse, alcoholism, self acceptance, identity and toxic masculinity.

results.title: Hand Me Down
results.overview: Eve is donating her childhood dollhouse away to an antique store ran by a lonely old woman Lynne. As Eve explores the stores treasures, filled with memories of their past owners, she warms to Lynnes helpfulness. Picking out a recipe book, she takes it home to discover Lynnes name written in it. As an act of kindness, she brings a birthday cake baked from the recipe book back to Lynne at the store, with a new mindset and hope to retrieve her dollhouse back. Lynne is delighted by Eves recreation of her childhood cake, taking her back down memory lane, but as Eve bargains to take her dollhouse back, a little girl in the store begs her mother to purchase it. Eve watches as her item finds its new owners, reassured she is passing down a treasure for the girl to cherish as she did.

results.title: Legs!
results.overview: Two pairs of legs, Lennon and Lindsey, embrace the challenging journey to explore if their continuous encounters really are just coincidences.

results.title: Repo
results.overview: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

results.title: Aali Mothi Shahani
results.overview: a young girl who makes an innocent wish to Lord Ganesha to grow up into an adult so she can make her own choices and do whatever she desires.

results.title: Le Grand Virage
results.overview: On the track at the Bretagne Velodrome, Nahel and Lauryne, two 16-year-old athletes, are training for the French Championships. They dream of a place on the podium and of recognition.

results.title: Metamorphosis
results.overview: ​This short drama film follows Ethan, a young book reviewer obsessed with perfection, turns to AI after losing all inspiration, and what starts as a harmless shortcut soon becomes something he can’t control. ​Inspired by Franz Kafka's Metamorphosis.

results.title: Spin Me
results.overview: Every day, two teachers devote all their energy to their autistic students, believing that they will “catch up”—that they will learn to read, count, tell time, take care of themselves, and move on to fifth grade alongside neurotypical children. But along the way, a question arises: Is catching up really the goal?

results.title: Foka
results.overview: Dr. Dimitri Foka, a Greek doctor from Turkey, survives a Nazi execution in Greece during World War II thanks to his Turkish passport. After graduating, he returns to his hometown, the island of Imroz (Gökçeada), part of Turkey, and becomes the island’s only doctor for many years. Following the Cyprus problem in 1964, state policies targeting the Greek population lead to dispossession, violence, and forced migration on the island, yet Foka refuses to leave.

results.title: Despedirse
results.overview: After a tragic event, Noah must take a road trip to say goodbye.

results.title: Ferret-Man
results.overview: After buying a video game from a yard sale, a guy inputs a cursed cheat code that sends the character out of the game, seeking freedom.

results.title: La guerre des sens
results.overview: Iris has always believed that beauty lies in what we look at and listen to. The creature, however, only has eyes for what she can smell, touch, and taste.

results.title: Le Pimple
results.overview: A whimsical explanation for why pimples seem to appear out of nowhere.

results.title: Tills stjärnorna faller ner
results.overview: Sylvia and Marek are getting married. It's a scorching summer day and the entire family is gathered. But when the drink starts flowing and the dancing begins love is put to the test, loyalties are questioned and secrets are revealed.

results.title: Quarter Century
results.overview: Quarter Century is a quiet exploration of a universal yet deeply personal question: What does it truly mean to exist?
